The Oscars ceremony is moving to YouTube starting in 2029, the Academy of Motion Picture Arts and Sciences announced on Wednesday.

The Oscars’ shift to YouTube, away from its home on ABC since the 1970’s. marks a major move for awards shows away from broadcast television.

Tap the link in our bio for everything we know about the deal, which will see the awards ceremony offered on YouTube for free and will see the platform retain streaming rights through at least 2033. | CBS LA | Facebook
